text.en: This Order may be cited as the Fire Service Act (Amendment) Order, 2006. of section 2 of Chapter 82.

Section 2 of the Fire Service Act (Chapter 82), in this Order referred to as Act, is amended in the defmition of "Director11 by deleting "the Fire and by substituting "Fire and Rescue" therefor. of Chapter 82.

The principal Act is amended by deleting "Fire Service" wherever those words appear and by substituting "Fire and Rescue" therefor. Made this 7th. day of Rejab, 1427 Hijriah corresponding to the 1st. day Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM AWANG MOHIDIN BIN HAJI DAUD, Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam. B$5.00
